QuestInfo.name: Clutching Pearls 1
QuestInfo.0: You came to Aqua Road to help make Cygnus's new dress. Can you really get all the materials in the ocean? Talk to Kizan for details.
QuestInfo.1: Kizan wants you to get Aqua Road White Pearls. Hunt #bSparkers#k and #bFreezers#k to get #b5 Aqua Road White Pearls#k.\r\n#b(You can go below the ground Kizan is standing on.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You collected all the White Pearls and gave them to Kizan.

0.0: I hear that you can get White Pearls in the ocean here. Take the ladder below me and you'll find Sparkers and Freezers.
0.1: Hunt Sparkers and Freezers to get 5 #bAqua Road White Pearls#k!
